visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a man with black hair and black-rimmed glasses sleeping soundly with his mouth open. He is leaning against a high-backed blue padded chair. The setting is a dimly lit studio or hobby room, with shelves in the background densely packed with colorful model kits and figurines. A small yellow star graphic is overlaid near his shoulder. (2) A woman with long hair and glasses enters the frame from the left, wearing a black t-shirt. She reaches out her right hand and taps the sleeping man's shoulder to wake him up. Bright pink and white variety-style text overlays the center of the frame. The background lighting is warm and highlights the intricate details of the hobby collectibles on the shelves. (3) The man wakes up abruptly, adjusts his glasses, and begins talking enthusiastically to the camera. He wears a black T-shirt with a small graphic logo. The camera captures him from a medium close-up angle, showing his expressive facial movements and mouth as he speaks. The blue chair is prominently visible behind his head and shoulders, featuring vertical stitching and a sleek design. (4) A product showcase phase features a full-length shot of the blue OSIM gaming chair standing in the center of the studio. Large yellow and black stylized text overlays appear, identifying the product. The chair is equipped with armrests, a headrest, and wheels, set against a background of computer monitors and more hobby figurines under bright studio lighting. (5) The man demonstrates a wireless smartphone application while sitting in the chair. He holds a phone with a detailed Godzilla-themed case and places his index finger over the rear camera lens, which emits a red light. The setting remains the same studio, with soft light reflecting off his glasses. (6) A digital screen capture or close-up shows the phone interface displaying a pressure test result of '5.0' and the Chinese text for 'Mild'. The man holds the phone steadily with his right hand, pointing at the screen with his left index finger to emphasize the results. (7) Close-up shots focus on the chair's blue leather-like texture as internal massage rollers move rhythmically beneath the surface, creating visible bumps and shifts in the fabric. The man mimics these movements with his fists held in front of the camera. The woman is later seen leaning back in the chair with her eyes closed, demonstrating its comfort. (8) The man demonstrates the mechanical footrest, pulling it out from underneath the seat with his hands. He then transitions to using a separate black foot massager placed on the floor. He looks relaxed and satisfied, gesturing toward the device. (9) The video concludes with the man standing and speaking directly to the camera in a medium shot, delivering final recommendations with a friendly expression and giving a thumbs-up. A brand slogan appears in large yellow text over his chest.
